MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it brings front-door alerts into my Alexa setup and connects with my earlier interest in home security.",
    "The external DVD drive fits my pattern of buying practical readers and adapters to keep older media accessible on my computers."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Fire TV Stick and Echo Dot repeat needs covered by my newer devices; sharing the same brand and functions gives me little reason to choose them now.",
    "The tablet does not address a need I have shown, and the AirTag assumes an iPhone that my history does not establish.",
    "The larger Echo Show and clock-equipped Dot have appealing features, but my recent Show 5, stand and Dot purchases make another similar device less urgent."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it duplicates something I recently bought.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched to tablets and trackers without a clear connection to a task I currently need to accomplish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs are already covered; the Show 5 stand also suggests I am still completing that setup.",
    "I value accessories that add a useful capability to equipment I own, as shown by my legacy-media readers, adapters and replacement batteries.",
    "The scale and compatibility of an addition matter: I would start with a doorbell before a whole-home camera bundle, and check my computer before choosing an internal SSD."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and practical-computing interests, but miss that I currently favor useful additions over overlapping devices."
}
